Context: None

Question: I am an instructor on an archery range.

Options: 
A. So I should clean my gun.
B. So I should bring a gun to work.
C. So I should teach people how to shoot a bow and arrow. 
D. So I should take a lunch break while my students are shooting. 

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
